extraction.name: Cleaned YODAS (OWSM v4)
extraction.description: A cleaned subset of the YODAS web-crawled speech dataset, containing 166,000 hours of speech across 75 languages. The dataset was created by applying a scalable data-cleaning pipeline to the raw YODAS data, including resegmentation using CTC, LID-based filtering, and CTC-score-based filtering. It is used alongside previous OWSM data to train the OWSM v4 series of open speech foundation models.
extraction.creator: Yifan Peng, Muhammad Shakeel, Yui Sudo, William Chen, Jinchuan Tian, Chyi-Jiunn Lin, Shinji Watanabe
extraction.publisher: Carnegie Mellon University; Honda Research Institute Japan
extraction.citeAs: Peng, Y., Shakeel, M., Sudo, Y., Chen, W., Tian, J., Lin, C.-J., Watanabe, S. (2025). OWSM v4: Improving Open Whisper-Style Speech Models via Data Scaling and Cleaning. Interspeech 2025.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset is derived from YODAS, a large-scale web-crawled speech dataset. The authors applied a three-step scalable data-cleaning pipeline using public toolkits: (1) resegmentation of long-form audio and text using CTC segmentation with OWSM-CTC v3.2 model, (2) LID-based filtering using fastText for text and ECAPA-TDNN (SpeechBrain) for audio, retaining only utterances where the original language label matches both predictions, and (3) CTC-score-based filtering that discards utterances with low audio-text alignment quality.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Raw YODAS dataset (Youtube-Oriented Dataset for Audio and Speech), a web-crawled dataset with Creative Commons license containing 370k hours of audio in 149 languages, providing unsegmented long-form recordings with timestamped text transcriptions.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Long-form audio recordings were segmented into shorter utterances with a maximum duration of 30 seconds after CTC-based realignment. Utterances consisting exclusively of non-speech elements such as music were removed.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Three-step pipeline: (1) Resegmentation - realign audio and text using CTC segmentation algorithm with pre-trained OWSM-CTC v3.2 model, segment into max 30-second utterances, remove non-speech; (2) LID-based filtering - perform LID on audio (ECAPA-TDNN/SpeechBrain) and text (fastText), retain only utterances where both predictions match the original label; (3) CTC-score-based filtering - rank CTC confidence scores per language and discard long-form utterances with any short utterance in the lowest θCTC=0.10 quantile. Speech features use 128 Mel filterbanks with 80ms time shift.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Original transcriptions are from the raw YODAS dataset (web-crawled). Language labels and audio-text alignments were automatically verified/corrected using pre-trained models (OWSM-CTC v3.2 for alignment, fastText and ECAPA-TDNN for LID).
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: CTC confidence scores quantify alignment quality between audio and text. Scores are language-dependent, so ranking and relative quantile thresholds (θCTC) are used per language. Threshold of 0.10 was selected empirically by fine-tuning OWSM v3.1 small on data filtered at various thresholds and evaluating on Common Voice and long-form ASR.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: OWSM-CTC v3.2 (for CTC segmentation/realignment), fastText (text-based LID), ECAPA-TDNN from SpeechBrain (spoken LID), ESPnet toolkit, PyTorch, FlashAttention-2
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The authors will publicly release the cleaned YODAS data, pre-trained models, training code, training logs, and data-cleaning scripts via the ESPnet toolkit.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: The dataset contains speech data in 75 languages from web-crawled sources (YouTube), which may implicitly contain information about language and speaking styles.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The work advances open academic research on speech foundation models by releasing fully open resources (data, models, code, logs) to address concerns about privacy, transparency, and reproducibility associated with proprietary industrial models.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The distribution across languages is highly imbalanced. English constitutes the largest share (74.6k hours out of 166.4k), while many other languages remain underrepresented. The authors kept the original distribution without resampling.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The raw YODAS data contains annotation errors including mismatched language labels and audio-text misalignment. The cleaning pipeline relies on pre-trained OWSM-CTC v3.2 which supports only a subset of YODAS languages (83 out of 149 after resegmentation, 75 after filtering). Language distribution is highly imbalanced with many underrepresented languages. Some languages may still have suboptimal filtering thresholds since a single global threshold (θCTC=0.10) was used.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training speech foundation models for multilingual automatic speech recognition (ASR), spoken language identification (LID), and speech translation (ST). Used to train the OWSM v4 series models (AED and CTC variants, 100M-1B parameters).
